default: empty native bag; portable grid defaults apply
effect: configures AG Grid pagination, sorting, filters, callbacks and native column definitions

precedence: Control-local portable definitions are used unless agGridOptions.columnDefs supplies native definitions; removed global config.columnDefs is ignored

namespace: TemplateLayout component registry declared through the broad Control option vocabulary

effect: none on Control; TemplateLayout can resolve host-provided named components
precedence: a Control-local components map does not override the TemplateLayout registry; matches React createExtendedRenderers components input
consumer: no direct Control consumer; packages/jsonforms-svelte-extended/src/lib/layouts/TemplateLayoutRenderer.svelte and React extended-renderers/src/index.tsx use renderer-registration inputs

namespace: Label markup interpolation declared through the broad Control option vocabulary
